title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: when the desk may grant a commercial goodwill waiver
content:
## Scope

This policy of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category governs commercial goodwill waivers on an invoice line of a per-container record: who may ask, how many a customer may receive, the request window, the one-per-line limit and the waivers the desk may never grant.

## Policy clauses

1. The desk may grant one commercial goodwill waiver on an invoice line at the billed party's request, recorded as commercial goodwill.
2. The desk grants the full goodwill amount computed on the basis in force, never a smaller figure of its own choosing.
3. The customer's goodwill waivers in the trailing 365 days must be fewer than the product's trailing-year allowance.
4. The waiver must be requested no later than the product's request window in calendar days after the invoice being waived was issued. The window ends on the invoice date plus the product's window days, counted on calendar dates, and a request on the last day is inside it.
5. Each invoice line takes at most one goodwill waiver.
6. When a dispute on the invoice is still submitted, the dispute is decided first and goodwill is computed on what remains.
7. Products whose goodwill percentage limit is 0 give no goodwill.
8. Waivers for a carrier-caused delay or a terminal closure are granted only by the operations department and never by the desk.

## Clause no longer in force for demurrage lines

"The waiver is at most the product's goodwill percentage of the amount still open on the invoice line after earlier credits and waivers, and never more than the product's goodwill money limit, rounded down to the cent." This clause is **no longer in force** as the basis for goodwill on a demurrage invoice line, where the current demurrage goodwill basis replaces it.

## How the trailing-year count is taken

The count covers the trailing 365 calendar days ending on the waiver date, that day included, across all records of the customer, and counts only waivers recorded as commercial goodwill. The line's records, not the customer's recollection, supply the count and the invoice date.

## Eligibility checklist

| Check | Must hold |
|---|---|
| Goodwill percentage limit of the product | above 0 |
| Commercial goodwill waivers of the customer in the trailing 365 days | fewer than the product's allowance |
| Request date | not later than the invoice date plus the product's request window |
| Earlier goodwill waiver on the same line | none |
| Submitted dispute on the invoice | decided first |
| Reason is a carrier-caused delay or terminal closure | not for the desk; operations department only |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical allowance of 2 and window of 20 days, chosen only for illustration)

- The customer has received 1 commercial goodwill waiver in the trailing 365 days: 1 is fewer than 2, so the allowance is met. With 2 already received, it is not.
- An invoice dated 1 May: a request on 21 May is inside the illustrative window; a request on 22 May is outside it.
